title: Inside a right-end event: last digit 13 halts, 11, 12, 14 and up are ordinary hits
text: At the bottom of every right-end event of 1RB1LF_1LC1RB_1LE1LD_1LB0RD_1LF---_1LA0LA is a sub-visit of a two-digit word (a, b): the hit of the last digit b, whose b erased Y's become walls for a new counter. In Lean, for every tape to the left: the hit of a last digit 13 halts, so does the hit 8 0 0, and the events with b = 11, 12, 14 to 20 are ordinary hits, one more rule h(b) = g(b) of the recursion (44,000 random words agree). Events with b at most 10 shift the pairs by one cell; they are what is left to understand. All 524,287 words of at most 18 pairs: 409 halt, through 218 halting hits. The run's eight events, logged in the accelerated run, meet no halting hit.
